rationale: Direct parent: the promoted tree with all of its inherited lineage. This ticket changes only the final-padding output stores and the matching proof and artifact-mirror files.
evidence: Every byte outside the final-padding output block is identical to the parent. The child differs from the parent only in those bytes, in PadOutput.lean and PadSites.lean, in the regenerated CandidateBytes.lean and CandidateArtifact.lean, and in README.md and dependencies.json.
